$comment: Forum palette and shared constants. Source of truth for the PWA and the Windows app. The macOS app keeps its own copy in Sources/tiro/design.swift (upstream, untouched). Run `node scripts/gen-tokens.mjs` after editing.

font.display: 'Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', Palatino, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif
font.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
font.mono: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

mark.$comment: Tironian et, two strokes in a 48-unit box (SVG y-down). Same paths as tironianPaths() in design.swift.

constants.$comment: Behavioural constants shared by every client. TAP_THRESHOLD and pre-roll match upstream main.swift.
